notes: All 12 network ports are 10/100/1000Mbps shielded Neutrik EtherCon connectors (a ruggedized locking RJ45 variant used widely in touring/live-event gear); mapped to connector id "rj45" since EtherCon is not a distinct option in the schema. Ports 1-10 are on the front panel, ports 11-12 on the rear. PoE sourcing (up to 160W spread across the 10 front ports) is only available with an optional add-on PoE supply module (LU 01 00051-GC12); the base unit as sold has no PoE output, so no PoE was marked as standard. No SFP/fiber ports, no console/RJ45 management port, and no backup/redundant power input exist on the GigaCore 12 (those appear only on the 14R/16Xt/16RFO siblings per the same datasheet). Product was discontinued (~Jan 2024), superseded by GigaCore 16t, but specs are well documented and unambiguous. Source used: official Luminex "GigaCore Ethernet Switches Specifications" datasheet (PDF) covering the GigaCore 12/14R/16Xt/16RFO family; cross-checked against the official GigaCore 12 Quick Start Guide (rear/front panel diagrams) and Markertek/B&H retail listings, all consistent.

ports.note: Front panel, shielded Neutrik EtherCon (ruggedized locking RJ45)

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Rear panel IEC inlet with fuse holder (3.15A 250V slow-blow); 100-240VAC 50-60Hz, max 30W (up to 180W with optional PoE supply module)
